description:
## What

Rename `SmimeProfile` (currently the Mailbox-validated Strict baseline)
to `SmimeMailboxValidated` so that the four S/MIME validation-tier
Profile types follow a single consistent naming pattern:

- `SmimeMailboxValidated` (renamed from `SmimeProfile`)
- `SmimeOrganizationValidated` (pending PKIX-jbvb.1)
- `SmimeSponsorValidated` (shipped, PKIX-jbvb.7)
- `SmimeIndividualValidated` (shipped, PKIX-jbvb.7)

Currently `SmimeProfile` is a one-off naming inconsistency — every
other tier-specific S/MIME Profile follows `Smime{Type}Validated`.
The Multipurpose addition (PKIX-jbvb.9.1) would otherwise force an
even uglier name (`SmimeProfileMultipurpose` or
`SmimeMailboxValidatedMultipurpose` alongside `SmimeProfile`).

Pre-1.0 breaking change — free per AGENTS.md prelaunch framing.

## Scope

### `pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs`

- Struct rename: `SmimeProfile` → `SmimeMailboxValidated`.
- Free-function rename: `smime_policy` → `smime_mailbox_policy`.
- Shape-check alias rename: `check_smime_shape` → `check_smime_mailbox_shape`.
- Update all internal references (rustdoc cross-links, the lib.rs
  top-level table, the `LintProfile` impl, the inline tests).
- `id()` value: `"cabf.smime"` → `"cabf.smime.mailbox"` for parity
  with `cabf.smime.sponsor` / `cabf.smime.individual`. This is a
  separate breaking change for any consumer reading the id string;
  call out in CHANGELOG.

### Other crates

Grep workspace-wide for `SmimeProfile`, `smime_policy`, `check_smime_shape`,
`"cabf.smime"` references:

- `pkix-chain` use-case wrappers: `verify_smime_signer`, etc. — likely
  imports `SmimeProfile` or `smime_policy` for default Profile.
- `pkix-profiles` (if it imports — should not, but verify).
- Doc tests and examples.

Update all sites.

### Deprecated aliases

Optional: ship deprecated type aliases `pub use SmimeMailboxValidated as SmimeProfile;`
and `pub use smime_mailbox_policy as smime_policy;` with `#[deprecated]`
attributes, so any external consumer (none yet, but documented exception
for the brief pre-1.0 window before this lands) gets a clean migration
warning. Probably overkill pre-1.0; defer unless requested.

## Acceptance

- All renames land in `pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs`.
- Workspace-wide grep for old names returns zero hits.
- `cargo test --workspace --all-features` passes.
- `cargo clippy -p pkix-profiles-cabf --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
- CHANGELOG entry in `pkix-profiles-cabf/CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
  documents the rename(s) under `### Breaking`.
- Commit message: `refactor(pkix-profiles-cabf): rename SmimeProfile → SmimeMailboxValidated`.

## Blocks

- **Blocks PKIX-jbvb.9.1** (Mailbox Multipurpose) — the Multipurpose
  sibling name (`SmimeMailboxValidatedMultipurpose`) requires the
  renamed Strict sibling to land first.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jbvb.9 (epic — Multipurpose surface)
- PKIX-jbvb.7 (the Strict-naming pattern this aligns with)
title: pkix-profiles-cabf: rename SmimeProfile → SmimeMailboxValidated for naming consistency
